text.tspan: New drugs approved in the United States, by designations
Annual number of new drugs approved by the US Center for Drug Evaluation and Research that fall under each
designation, including Orphan Drugs, Fast Track, Accelerated Approval, Breakthrough Therapy, and Qualified
Data source: US Food and Drug Administration (2025)
Note: Designations can be overlapping; a drug can receive multiple designations or no designation at all. CDER is part of the US Food and Drug
